title: On the p-adic Wirsing problem
summary: For a real transcendental number $ξ$, let $ω_n^*(ξ)$ denote the supremum of all $ω$ for which there exist infinitely many real algebraic numbers $α$ of degree $\leq n$ satisfying $|ξ-α|\leq H(α)^{-ω-1}$, where $H(α)$ is the naive height of the minimal polynomial of $α$. A celebrated result of Wirsing gives the uniform lower bound $ω_n^*(ξ)\geq\frac{n+1}{2}$, which was improved significantly in a recent work of Poëls to $\frac{n}{2-\log 2}$.
